Netaji's Grandnephew Plans New Political Party

Chandra Kumar Bose, grand-nephew of Subhas Chandra Bose, has announced plans to form a new political party named Azad Hind Party. He stated that the inspiration for this move came from protests by Gen Z. The party is intended to be youth-focused.
